A1.justification: Both PDFs describe UniScene and contain readable main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices A–H. The retained and added material can be reliably matched across versions.

before.justification: V1 reports original occupancy, video, LiDAR, and downstream perception experiments, including quantitative comparisons and ablations in Tables 2–12.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and adds qualitative generation results on Waymo and nuPlan in Appendix H, Figure 19.

M1.justification: The occupancy, video, and LiDAR generation procedures remain unchanged. Section 3.2 clarifies the existing depth-based warp and noise notation without establishing a different algorithm, architecture, or training objective.

E1.justification: V2 adds limited qualitative evaluation on Waymo and nuPlan in Appendix H. The existing NuScenes coverage and generation and downstream tasks are retained.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the quantitative tables and existing qualitative comparisons. The new Waymo and nuPlan examples show UniScene alone and introduce no evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The added transfer evaluation uses scene layouts and conditional reference images, with Waymo’s unavailable back view set to null. Existing NuScenes splits, preprocessing, metrics, and training settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Appendix H adds a qualitative cross-dataset generalization analysis through Figure 19. Existing component ablations, occupancy scaling analysis, OOD examples, and LiDAR beam-pattern analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or experimental error bars. The new qualitative examples introduce no statistical uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Figure 19 adds qualitative generation results for Waymo and nuPlan. Numerical results in Tables 2–12 and the existing qualitative findings remain unchanged; no measured transfer-performance improvement is reported.

T1.justification: V2 adds Equation 7 explicitly defining the target-to-reference pixel projection underlying Warp, which v1 leaves implicit. This is a limited mathematical specification; the other equation changes are notation clarification and renumbering, with no new theorem or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction’s contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about unified occupancy-centric generation, the two transfer strategies, generation quality, and downstream benefits.

C2.justification: Appendix H newly interprets the transfer examples as demonstrating applicability to other driving datasets using conditional reference images, while noting Waymo’s unavailable back view. Existing mechanism interpretations and resource-related limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Section 3.2 now specifies that warp intrinsics are scaled to latent-feature coordinates and identifies the transformation direction from target to conditional latent. These clarify implementation of the existing method; training details and access information are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2 removes the brief FB-Occ description and its in-text citation, although reference 36 remains in the bibliography. The remaining related-work discussion and novelty positioning are unchanged.

P1.justification: Editing is localized to the reprojection explanation, the FB-Occ sentence, and a short addition to Appendix H. The overall organization is retained. Appendix C.4’s equation references are left stale after renumbering.

P2.justification: V2 adds Figure 19, renumbers the former Figures 19–22 as 20–23, relocates Figure 4 within page 5, and reflows nearby material. Existing figure content and table structures are otherwise retained.

improvement.justification: V2 makes the existing warp more explicit and reproducible and adds limited visual evidence of transfer to Waymo and nuPlan. These are modest gains: quantitative validation is unchanged, the transfer evidence remains qualitative, and Appendix C.4 acquires a stale equation reference.
